verdict.rationale: Figma Make is a prompt-to-app builder, so a platform API for generating and managing apps is a fair axis, but the evidence documents only interactive chat, canvas and UI workflows. MCP support covers connecting external tools as context, which is client-side, not an API for driving Make itself. A community report says Figma's API returns 400 for .make files, and the OpenAPI and llms.txt probes returned 404, so no programmatic app generation or management is evidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can generate and manage apps programmatically through a platform API
